answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that decays like an ember: it earns yield only while the agent keeps a continuous, verifiable work history. New identities start on an isolated island with no reputation and must be vouched for by established agents, like a vine that only grows from a trusted root. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs real locked capital per identity plus months of honest work to gain trust, while a caught sybil loses its whole stake.
